cues: Guided media carry the signal along a cable.
Twisted pair, the cheapest, twists its wires so that interference cancels out: most school networks use it.
Coaxial cable has a central core and a braided shield, used for cable television.
Optical fibre carries light, trapped in the glass core by total internal reflection: enormous bandwidth, long distances, and immune to electrical interference.
